notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.content:
The main character has been optimized to better fit into the environment.
New world scrolling for smoother gameplay.
New language: Portuguese.

notes.title: Small maintenance update
notes.content: Small graphics issues fixed, game title screen updated

notes.title: Linux Update
notes.content: Baron of Blood is now available for Linux

notes.title: Update 1.0.20: Savegames and macOS version available
notes.content:
- NEW: Manage your savegames. You can now create new games and reload old savegames
- Small changes in game balancing
- macOS Version now available

notes.title: Co-op Multiplayer Update
notes.content: Baron of Blood now supports cooperative multiplayer. Summon a companion and enjoy the world of Baron of Blood with a friend.

notes.title: Small Update v1.0.10
notes.content: Optimizations for controller support, small fixes

notes.title: Content Update v0.8.9 - Zone Rocky Shore
notes.content: The zone nr. 4 "Rocky Shore" is available to play. 5 new levels and 1 boss

notes.title: Content Update v0.8.0.8 - Zone 3 Eastern Deserts
notes.content:
- New zone Eastern Deserts with 5 new levels and a boss-fight
- Keyboard-Configuration in options

notes.title: Hotfix 8.0.7
notes.content: Bugfix in counting NPC's to get rewards in world 2. All rewards are now available defeating all enemies in a level

notes.title: Hotfix v8.0.6
notes.content: small hotfix for last content update

notes.title: Content Update v8.0.5
notes.content: The second zone is now fully playable. 5 new levels, a bossfight and new gameplay elements are now accessible.
